mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, increasing norepinephrine levels which potentiates quinidine's cardiac effects and arrhythmia risk; quinidine also inhibits CYP2D6, potentially increasing isocarboxazid levels.
action: Avoid this combination; if necessary, use with extreme caution under close cardiac monitoring with ECG surveillance and blood pressure monitoring.
